007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
014
015/**
016 * Sample for updating multiple DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT tool attributes.
017 *
018 * <p>For a typed {@code tool_params} update on an existing SQL tool, see
019 * {@link SetSqlToolParamsSample}.</p>
020 * <p>For typed input names and descriptions, see {@link SetToolInputsSample}.</p>
021 */
022public final class SetToolAttributesSample {
023
024    private SetToolAttributesSample() {
025    }
026
027    /**
028     * Runs the sample using the configured tool type.
029     *
030     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
031     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
032     */
033    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
034        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
035        ToolAttributes attributes = ToolAttributes.builder()
036                .toolTypeValue(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_TYPE"))
037                .build();
038
039        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createClient()) {
040            Tool tool = selectAIAgent.tool(toolName);
041            boolean updated = tool.setAttributes(attributes);
042            System.out.printf("Set attributes on tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, updated);
043        }
044    }
045
046    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
047        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
048                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
049                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
050                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
051                .build());
052    }
053
054    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
055        String value = System.getenv(name);
056        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
057            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
058        }
059        return value;
060    }
061}
